title: Breakout
description: Breakout with six brick layouts, lives, knob and touch controls, difficulty settings, and saved progress

screens.name: HELP
screens.title: Breakout controls
items: Turn the knob clockwise to move right and counterclockwise to move left. Hold the controller tilted left or right for continuous movement.
Tap the court where you want your paddle horizontally. The arrow buttons also move it. The paddle stays inside the court.
Press the controller or tap Launch to release the ball. After clearing a level, Next level loads the next layout and launches when you are ready.
Clear all bricks to advance. Marks on a brick show its remaining hits when more than one is needed. Paddle edges produce steeper returns, and the ball speeds up as you play.
A hit earns 10 points times the level; breaking a brick adds another 20 times the level. Clearing a level earns 250 times the level and an extra life, up to five.
Missing the ball costs one life. Zero lives ends the game. Clear all six levels to win. Difficulty changes paddle width, ball speed and starting lives for a new game.
BACK or Pause returns to the menu and saves. Calls, popups, leaving the app and vehicle movement pause play. Resume explicitly when ready; a saved ball has a short ready pause.

screens.name: NEW_GAME
screens.title: Start a new game?
items: Your current saved game will be replaced. Your best score is kept.
